title: Subtitle settings policy editor
summary: Reworked the WebView Subtitles settings panel into an operational policy editor with language chip previews, a format policy matrix, destructive cleanup separation, and advanced details disclosures while preserving existing settings controls and save flow.
reason: Improve operator scan speed and reduce accidental use of destructive subtitle cleanup toggles without changing backend-owned routes, config keys, OCR behavior, or media policy semantics.
behavior_before: Subtitle settings were presented as raw language text fields followed by separate option panels where destructive drop-after-conversion toggles sat beside normal conversion controls.
behavior_after: Subtitle settings present language policy first, format policy as a contained matrix, destructive cleanup in a warning disclosure, and timing/OCR/detail fields in an advanced disclosure; existing DOM controls still stage the same backend save patch.
